sense: a business or office that acts for others

terms.gloss: an agency, an office: sēdēs periēgētica, a travel agency
terms.grammar: noun, third declension, with an adjective or a gerundive
evidence: M-O s.v. news agency: sēdēs nūntiīs dīvulgandīs (Egger)
terms.comment: Classically a seat or an abode; Traupman and Egger use it for an office that does business, with an adjective or a gerundive for the business. The agent himself is a prōcūrātor (see travel agent).

sources: Lewis & Short: sedes · Lewis & Short: procurator
Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: news agency.
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 219, checked against the searchable text of the book (9 November 2026).
